rows.name: Armbar (Juji-gatame Family)

rows.name: Kimura (Ude-garami Family)
rows.source: IBJJF: kimura is a double-grip ude-garami shoulder lock

rows.name: Omoplata
rows.source: IBJJF: omoplata is a shoulder lock using the legs to control the arm

rows.name: Triangle Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: sankaku-jime is a vascular strangle compressing the carotids

rows.name: Back Take to Rear Naked Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: rear naked choke (hadaka-jime) is a blood choke on the neck

rows.name: Straight Ankle Lock
rows.source: IBJJF: ashikanbase-gatame targets the ankle joint

rows.name: Heel Hook (Inside/Outside Family)
rows.source: IBJJF: heel hook torques the knee via the heel

rows.name: D'Arce & Anaconda Chain
rows.source: IBJJF: d'arce and anaconda are both front headlock chokes

rows.name: Rear Naked Choke
rows.source: IBJJF / Kodokan: hadaka-jime, the textbook blood choke

rows.name: Americana (Ude-garami Top Variation)
rows.source: IBJJF: americana is a top-position ude-garami shoulder lock

rows.name: Guillotine Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: guillotine is a front headlock choke on the neck

rows.name: Arm Triangle (Kata-gatame Choke)
rows.source: IBJJF: kata-gatame is a shoulder choke compressing the carotids; id contains 'arm' but it is a choke
rows.note: id contains 'arm' but the technique is a choke (kata-gatame), not an armlock

rows.name: D'Arce Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: d'arce is a front headlock arm-triangle variation choke

rows.name: Anaconda Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: anaconda is a front headlock D'Arce-variant choke

rows.name: Bow-and-Arrow Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: bow-and-arrow (yoko-eri-jime variant) is a back-take collar choke

rows.name: Cross-Collar Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: cross-collar (juji-jime) is a lapel choke compressing the trachea

rows.name: Ezekiel Choke (Sode-guruma-jime)
rows.source: Kodokan / IBJJF: sode-guruma-jime is a sleeve-wheel choke

rows.name: Clock Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: clock choke is a collar-based front choke

rows.name: Baseball Bat Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: baseball bat choke grips the collar like a bat and compresses the neck

rows.name: North-South Choke
rows.source: IBJJF: north-south choke compresses the trachea from the north-south position

rows.name: Gogoplata
rows.source: IBJJF: gogoplata uses the shin/foot to choke from a rubber-guard position

rows.name: Wrist Lock Family
rows.source: IBJJF: wrist lock (kote-gaeshi family) hyperextends the wrist joint

rows.name: Bicep Slicer
rows.source: IBJJF: bicep slicer compresses the upper arm via a leg-driven figure-four

rows.name: Kneebar
rows.source: IBJJF: kneebar hyperextends the knee joint

rows.name: Toe Hold
rows.source: IBJJF: toe hold twists the foot to torque the knee and ankle

rows.name: Calf Slicer
rows.source: IBJJF: calf slicer compresses the lower leg via a leg-driven figure-four

rows.name: Guillotine → Mount Finish
rows.source: IBJJF: sequence node; lead action is a guillotine choke on the neck

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-juji-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: juji-gatame is the textbook cross-arm elbow lock

rows.name: Sankaku-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: sankaku-jime is a triangle choke, a vascular strangle; id contains 'sankaku' like the arm-lock compound but -jime marks it a choke
rows.note: name contains 'sankaku' but -jime suffix marks it a choke, not an armlock

rows.name: Nami-juji-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: nami-juji-jime is a basic cross-collar strangle

rows.name: Gyaku-juji-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: gyaku-juji-jime is a reverse cross-collar strangle

rows.name: Kata-juji-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: kata-juji-jime is a half cross-collar strangle

rows.name: Hadaka-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: hadaka-jime is the bare-hand rear naked choke

rows.name: Okuri-eri-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: okuri-eri-jime is a sliding collar choke from the back

rows.name: Kataha-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: kataha-jime is a single-wing collar choke

rows.name: Katate-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: katate-jime is a one-hand choke

rows.name: Ryote-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: ryote-jime is a two-hand choke

rows.name: Sode-guruma-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: sode-guruma-jime is a sleeve-wheel choke

rows.name: Tsukkomi-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: tsukkomi-jime is a thrusting choke using the lapel

rows.name: Do-jime
rows.source: Kodokan: do-jime is a torso compression lock (illegal in IJF competition)

rows.name: Ude-garami
rows.source: Kodokan: ude-garami is the arm entanglement, parent of kimura/americana

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-ude-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: arm crush lock using the arm itself as leverage

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-hiza-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: arm lock using the knee as a fulcrum against the elbow

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-waki-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: armpit arm lock compressing the elbow against the torso

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-hara-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: belly arm lock using the abdomen as a fulcrum

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-ashi-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: leg arm lock using the leg to lever the elbow; despite 'ashi' in the name, it attacks the arm

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-te-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: hand arm lock bending the wrist/elbow

rows.name: Ude-hishigi-sankaku-gatame
rows.source: Kodokan: triangle-shaped arm lock; id contains 'sankaku' but -gatame with ude-hishigi prefix marks it an armlock, not a choke
rows.note: id contains 'sankaku' (triangle) but ude-hishigi prefix marks it an armlock, not a choke

rows.name: Ashi-garami
rows.source: Kodokan: ashi-garami is a leg entanglement attacking the knee/hip
rows.note: catalogue carries arm_isolation effect key but ashi-garami is a leg entanglement (ashi = leg); the effect key is a catalogue error

rows.source: FIAS: straight ankle lock (akhilles) attacks the ankle joint

rows.name: Kneebar
rows.source: FIAS: kneebar hyperextends the knee

rows.name: Rolling Kneebar Entry
rows.source: FIAS: rolling entry into a knee lock

rows.name: Bent Leg Kneebar
rows.source: FIAS: bent-leg variant of the knee lock

rows.name: Throw to Leg Entanglement
rows.source: FIAS: throw chain into a leg entanglement submission
